notes:
POC started 2025-11; scope: embed search + customer support assistant (hybrid reranking + embeddings) for investor relations use cases. POC artifacts: sample dataset (redacted), ingest pipeline notes, 3 prompt templates.

Sequence/timeline (condensed):
- 2025-09-12: inbound from growth; AE Jordan attached. initial discovery call — compliance-heavy.
- 2025-10-02: scoping call w/ Head of Data (Anika Chen) and Security (Dirk H.). agreed to POC: Dedicated pool + VPC peering, end-to-end audit logs.
- 2025-11-15: kickoff (Fireflies ff_2025-11-15_8693). SE Maya ran integration checklist; initial ingest successful.
- 2025-12-05: milestone 1 (indexing + basic reranker) missed — engineering deprioritized for year-end regulatory deliverables.
- 2026-01-27: security follow-up call (ff_2026-01-27_10234). Security asked for SOC2 Type II evidence, KMS integration diagram, and data residency attestation.
- 2026-02-10: procurement asked for line-item pricing for dedicated 4xA10G; finance hit freeze (Q1 hiring freeze → capex hold).
- 2026-02-18: last outreach — AE escalated to Dir. Data Product; champion (Anika) responded: "We need 6 engineers to finish POC; hiring pause means this will be delayed."

Current status: POC effectively stalled. Engineering cycles unavailable; security demands (SOC2/ISO artefacts + legal hold on data residency) are blocking go/no-go. No formal cancellation but no timelines. Internal champion bandwidth has evaporated (Anika moved to a different program owner role, limited availability).

Competitive risk: procurement doing parallel evals; signals from vendor RFP show Anthropic and OpenAI responded with SOC2 collateral faster — procurement favoring vendor with lighter integration friction (hosted offering).

Engagement attempts to date: 6 cold/warm outreaches since 2026-02; left voicemail with CIO (2/19), emailed extended checklist and compressed pilot offer (2/21).

Possible recovery paths / recommended next steps:
- Offer a short, low-effort smoke test using hosted API (read-only) with strict retention controls to demonstrate value while security review completes.
- Provide SOC2 evidence pack + ISO summary and a templated KMS integration diagram (SE action).
- Propose a time-boxed scoped deliverable: 2-week demo + 1 week handoff that requires only 1 engineer from LF (we can cover the rest).
- If budget frozen, suggest a Q3 reserved capacity conversion with early pilot credits to keep momentum.

Stakeholders:
- Technical champion (was): Anika Chen, Head of Data (limited availability)
- Security contact: Dirk H., Sr. InfoSec (raised legal/residency asks)
- Procurement: Marisol Vega (request for formal quote + vendor comparison)
- Executive sponsor: VP Product (intro call requested but not scheduled)

Open items / blockers to resolve:
- Provide SOC2 Type II evidence and ISO summary (SE -> deliver by 2026-03-05)
- Confirm KMS options and diagram for on-prem/VPC flow (action: Maya Rivera)
- Procurement itemized quote showing pilot-friendly terms and walkaway criteria

Sales notes / tone: short, factual. Primary risk = no internal champion + budget freeze. Win improbable without exec-level re-engagement or simplifying the pilot. Document as CLOSED/ON-HOLD in CRM if no re-engagement by 2026-04-01.

"If you can give SOC2 evidence and a one-engineer pilot plan, we can look at reopening this summer." — Marisol V.
